notes: The Junior range is sold in Australia as both 'Ibrida' (petrol hybrid) and 'Elettrica' (BEV); the Ibrida is excluded entirely as it is not a BEV. Only one named Elettrica trim could be confirmed from the official site's spec block (115kW/260Nm, 54kWh, WLTP 407km); the multiple price points reported by CarExpert for 2026 ($58,990 before on-road costs base, with drive-away figures spanning $50,117-$64,057 and separately $60,813/$62,913/$64,057) most likely reflect colour and option-pack pricing rather than genuinely distinct named sub-variants, so a single Elettrica row is used rather than inventing separate trim names. DC fast-charge time is quoted as ~27 minutes (20-80%) on the official AU site vs ~30 minutes (10-80%) in a Stellantis press release; the official AU site figure is preferred.
